maddeler.e:
أجترم (form VIII)
# أَجْتَرِمُ (ʔajtarimu) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.ri.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# أُجْتَرَمُ (ʔujtaramu) /ʔud͡ʒ.ta.ra.mu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# أَجْتَرِمَ (ʔajtarima) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.ri.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# أُجْتَرَمَ (ʔujtarama) /ʔud
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
